boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 135 seals a tall column on the left edge behind a counter that must hit zero. The top row's blue `6`/`6`/`9` tiles, a yellow 2×2 dot block, and a cyan bidirectional slider create a lateral puzzle in a vertical frame. The green right-strip feeds the exit lane — push it before the left-rail counter zeroes out and the sealed column stays locked forever.
landmarks: Block Out Level 135 seals a tall column on the left edge behind a counter that must hit zero.
The top row's blue `6`/`6`/`9` tiles, a yellow 2×2 dot block, and a cyan bidirectional slider create a lateral puzzle in a vertical frame.
The green right-strip feeds the exit lane — push it before the left-rail counter zeroes out and the sealed column stays locked forever.

quickTips: Break the yellow dot block before sliding the ↔ piece — reversing that order locks the left rail above 4.
Clear the green right-strip only after the black-bordered 2 tile unlocks.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Spend the left-rail 9 counter by sliding the top blue 6/6/9 trio rightward off the tall left panel.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Break the yellow 2×2 dot block without splitting the cyan ↔ slider in the center.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Push the cyan double-arrow piece through the center once the left rail drops to 4 and 7.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Clear the green right-strip > lane after the black-bordered 2 tile unlocks.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Feed the bottom red/green/blue cluster down the green bottom-arrow exit.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Spend the final left-rail 2 on the tall purple column and clear the last scraps for the board clear.

failurePoints: Sliding the ↔ piece before the yellow dot block breaks, locking the left rail above 4.
Sending the bottom red cluster down the green arrow before the 2 tile unlocks, stranding the right-strip lane.
